name: Prompt
description: Composes chat input with attachments and pickers, switching Send to Stop while the assistant works.
propsSummary: placeholder: string (default: Ask, search or chat…)

onValueChange.description: Called with the new text on every change

onSubmit.description: Called with the text when the message is sent

placeholder.description: Hint in the empty text area

disabled.description: Nothing can be typed or sent

readOnly.description: The text can be read and selected, not changed or sent

invalid.description: The message can't be sent as written; pair with errorMessage

errorMessage.description: Why the message can't be sent, shown under the text

pending.description: Sending: Send shows a spinner after a second and Enter waits

working.description: The assistant is responding: the work wash plays, Send becomes Stop when onStop is set, the text stays editable

minRows.description: Rows before the text area grows

maxRows.description: Rows before the text area scrolls

submitOnEnter.description: Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line

onFiles.description: Receives files from Attach, paste and drop

accept.description: File types the attach, paste and drop paths take

when: Multi-line input with a submit action
Toolbars carrying attachments or a model picker
whenNot: Search-only fields (use Input with the search variant)
guidelines: Always pass onSubmit; pair working with onStop so Send becomes Stop
pending while the message is on its way; working while the assistant responds
The text stays editable while working, so the next message can be drafted
Prompt.Picker chooses one of a few options (a model, a mode) from a menu; its name is read before the value
Prompt.Submit is the one accent action; a menu on it opens by right-click, ArrowDown or long-press, never by a plain click
Wire onFiles once; the attach button, paste and drop all route through it
Render Prompt.Attachments above Prompt.Textarea; they are part of the message
invalid with errorMessage says why the message can't be sent
accessibility: Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line; Enter waits while pending or working
The frame draws one focus ring for the text area
Send and Stop are labelled buttons; the picker reads its name before its value
The error message is linked with aria-describedby and the text area reports aria-invalid
Working sets aria-busy; the drop hint is words, not only a ring

examples.name: Basic
examples.description: The text area, attach and Send.

examples.name: With Picker
examples.description: A model picker and a token count beside Send.
examples.code:
const models = [{ value: "fast", label: "Fast" }, { value: "thorough", label: "Thorough" }];
const [model, setModel] = React.useState("fast");
const send = (message: string) => {};

<Prompt onSubmit={send}>
  <Prompt.Textarea />
  <Prompt.Toolbar>
    <Prompt.Picker aria-label="Model" options={models} value={model} onValueChange={setModel} />
    <Prompt.Actions>
      <Prompt.Info>1.2k tokens</Prompt.Info>
      <Prompt.Submit />
    </Prompt.Actions>
  </Prompt.Toolbar>
</Prompt>

examples.name: While Working
examples.description: Send becomes Stop; the text stays editable.
examples.code:
const [responding, setResponding] = React.useState(true);
const send = (message: string) => setResponding(true);
const stop = () => setResponding(false);

<Prompt working={responding} onStop={stop} onSubmit={send}>
  <Prompt.Textarea />
  <Prompt.Toolbar>
    <Prompt.Actions>
      <Prompt.Submit />
    </Prompt.Actions>
  </Prompt.Toolbar>
</Prompt>

examples.name: With Attachments
examples.description: Attach, paste or drop files; chips sit above the text.

examples.name: Invalid
examples.description: Says why the message can't be sent.
examples.code:
const send = (message: string) => {};

<Prompt invalid errorMessage="Messages can be up to 4,000 characters." onSubmit={send}>
  <Prompt.Textarea />
</Prompt>

examples.name: Disabled
examples.description: Nothing can be typed or sent.
examples.code:
<Prompt disabled placeholder="Connect a repository to ask">
  <Prompt.Textarea />
</Prompt>

relations.note: Use Input for simple single-line text input
Use Textarea for multi-line without toolbar

propsSummary: disabled / readOnly / invalid + errorMessage: field states
working: boolean + onStop - the assistant is responding; Send becomes Stop
onFiles / accept: attach, paste and drop
